To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of WhatsApp is a constitutive part of dwelling with those close by, and that the particularities of WhatsApp are constitutive of this dwelling.
WhatsApp is used to create a sense of intimacy and togetherness, and that the use of this application is constitutive of the felt-life of dwelling.
WhatsApp is a platform for everyday dwelling with others, and this dwelling is constituted through a felt-life of togetherness, intimacy, and a sense of being together.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the everyday use of WhatsApp contributes to the making and maintaining of relationships, and how this is constitutive in the making of a felt-life.
how people use WhatsApp to be together with others, and how these relationships are constituted through the particularities of the application.
how everyday dwelling is enacted and how it can be understood in terms of the particularities of smartphone applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the smartphone IM applications, and in particular WhatsApp, are a new and important form of communication technology that enables new forms of relationship engagements.
dwelling is a way of being together with others, a way of being in the world.
WhatsApp is an everyday dwelling application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
WhatsApp is not just about communication, but is also about dwelling together, and this is a form of dwelling that is constitutive of the everyday life of the user.
WhatsApp is a technology that is constitutive of the everyday dwelling together, a dwelling that is made up of the continuous and small relationship doings of the participants.

the sociality of WhatsApp is constitutively entangled with the materiality of the application, and that this materiality is not a passive backdrop for social interaction, but an active part of it, and that this is a key part of the sociality of the application.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we should not be too quick to assume that the affordances of the technology are the only or even the primary determinant of how people use it.

the sociality of smartphone instant messaging applications are not just about being together in the moment, but also about the past and future, and how this is enacted through small, everyday, continuous traces of narratives.
dwelling with WhatsApp is an everyday practice of sociality that is constitutive of relationships and the sociality that is enacted in them.
